intro: StorageCafe has no city statistics or listings average for New Haven. UnitSight's September 2026 street-rate index, from 5 facilities and 97 listings, puts the standard 10x10 at $155. SpareFoot's unspecified 10x10 average was $146.26 on September 1, 2026, included here as $146. The advertised rate averages those two figures. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (UnitSight street rates; SpareFoot 10x10 average). No StorageCafe rate table; no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page.

units.notes: UnitSight standard street rate $91 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$132. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).
UnitSight standard street rate $155 (Sep 2026), 5 facilities. SpareFoot unspecified average $146.26 on Sep 1, 2026, rounded to $146. Climate-controlled on the UnitSight page ~$232.
